hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q 'push' || exit 0; echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') hook disparou" >> /tmp/deploy-hook.log; API_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL /home/gabriel/pro/push-it-app/.env 2>/dev/null | cut -d'"' -f2); LOCAL=$(git -C /home/gabriel/pro/pushit-backend rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); REMOTE=$(git -C /home/gabriel/pro/pushit-backend ls-remote origin HEAD 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); if [ "$LOCAL" != "$REMOTE" ]; then echo "Aviso: push pode nao ter chegado ao remote (local=$LOCAL remote=$REMOTE)"; fi; CURRENT=$(curl -s "$API_URL/status" | jq -r '.version'); echo "Monitorando deploy — versao atual em prod: $CURRENT"; COUNT=0; while [ $COUNT -lt 30 ]; do sleep 20; NEW=$(curl -s "$API_URL/status" | jq -r '.version'); if [ "$NEW" != "$CURRENT" ]; then echo "Deploy concluido: $CURRENT -> $NEW"; exit 2; fi; COUNT=$((COUNT+1)); echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') — ainda $CURRENT... ($COUNT/30)"; done; echo "Timeout apos 10min — versao ainda $CURRENT"; exit 2
